metadata.title: $G_2$-Laplacian flow on complete asymptotically conical manifolds
metadata.abstract: This paper proves the short-time existence of $G_2$-Laplacian flow for closed, asymptotically conical $G_2$-structures on a complete manifold, shows that this solution is unique among closed solutions, and gives a lower bound for the existence time depending on the initial geometry.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对完备非紧流形上的闭渐近锥 $G_2$ 结构证明 Laplacian 流短时存在、闭解类中的唯一性及由初始几何控制的存在时间下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 正文建立非紧 AC 背景所需的函数空间、近似解和最大值原理，补齐该流的基础适定性。
analysis.limitations: 只给短时理论；对扭率演化、长期收敛与奇点分类没有结论。
analysis.priorityReason: 100 分制：相关性 27/30、新颖性与强度 21/25、技术复用性 16/20、潜在影响 11/15、证据清晰度 8/10，总分 83/100。
